run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-17T19:33:37Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning for otel-demo/frontend is explained by a configuration change on the otel-demo/shipping Deployment. Between 19:32:17Z and 19:32:24Z the Deployment shipping rolled out a new ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8 whose shipping container sets QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000"; the ReplicaSet it replaced, shipping-75d58f5d84, set QUOTE_ADDR="http://quote:8080" with the same image. In the traces the error is shipping's /get-quote server span returning Internal Server Error with a child shipping client span named "POST " (empty URI) failing with Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat))); credit for the failure then travels as gRPC 13 INTERNAL "shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500" through checkout PlaceOrder and as HTTP 500 through frontend and frontend-proxy. Error spans for frontend, checkout and shipping were 0 at 19:12:20, 19:22:20 and 19:32:20 and non-zero at 19:42:20, matching the rollout, and frontend's span-based error share was 4.986% at 19:45:00Z. All pods in otel-demo are Running and Ready with 0 restarts, so this is a configuration/application failure, not a pod failure. quote and email show no error spans and flagd's fault flags are all off (flag-derived faults rejected).

claims.text: Deployment otel-demo/shipping (generation 2) configures the shipping container with env QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000"; the image is ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-shipping and no explicit email address variable is present.

The predecessor ReplicaSet shipping-75d58f5d84 (created 2026-11-17T18:55:46Z, replicas 0) set QUOTE_ADDR="http://quote:8080", while its successor shipping-5ffdc77bc8 (created 2026-11-17T19:32:17Z, replicas 1) sets QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000"; both use the same image and are controller-owned by Deployment shipping.

Events in otel-demo record the shipping rollout: 19:32:17Z Deployment shipping "Scaled up replica set shipping-5ffdc77bc8 from 0 to 1" and ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8 "Created pod: shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn"; 19:32:24Z Deployment shipping "Scaled down replica set shipping-75d58f5d84 from 1 to 0", ReplicaSet shipping-75d58f5d84 "Deleted pod: shipping-75d58f5d84-gw77q" and Pod shipping-75d58f5d84-gw77q "Stopping container shipping".

In trace 626562e79f7e4ed8e6c1bb394758573c (19:42:52Z) the shipping server span "/get-quote" (64µs) is error with otel.status_description "Internal Server Error", and its child shipping client span "POST " (10µs) is error with otel.status_description "Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat)))", i.e. the outbound request URI could not be parsed.

The same trace 626562e79f7e4ed8e6c1bb394758573c shows propagation: checkout span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder error with rpc.grpc.status_code 13 and description "shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500"; frontend spans POST, POST /api/checkout, "executing api route (pages) /api/checkout" and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder error with http.status_code 500; frontend-proxy spans "ingress" and "router frontend egress" error with http.status_code 500; load-generator span POST error with http.status_code 500. No span of service email appears in this trace.

A read slice of 30 of the 233 stored checkout error spans for 18:33:37Z–19:47:20Z shows every oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder error carrying the identical otel.status_description "shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500" with matching exception.message.

Hourly error-span increases over 18:33:37Z–19:47:20Z were: frontend 1713.58, concentrated on span_name POST, POST /api/checkout, "executing api route (pages) /api/checkout" and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (about 428 each); checkout 850.53 on "HTTP POST" and oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder; shipping 852.63 on "/get-quote" and "POST "; frontend-proxy 888.26.

Baseline and onset from 5-minute error-span increases over 18:47:20Z–19:47:20Z: frontend was 0 at 19:12:20, 19:22:20 and 19:32:20 and 663.29 at 19:42:20; checkout and shipping were 0 at those three earlier points and 331.65 at 19:42:20, so the deviation starts after the 19:32:24Z shipping rollout.

Shipping's outbound client span changed with the rollout: span_name "POST quote" carried about 200–220 calls per 5 minutes through 19:32:20, fell to 19.54 at 19:37:20 and 0 at 19:42:20 and 19:47:20, while the new span_name "POST " (empty URI) first appears at 19:37:20 with 122.5 calls per 5 minutes and is the error series counted under shipping.

quote traffic ceased after the rollout: its spans POST /getquote, calculate-quote and {closure} each ran about 150–220 per 5 minutes until 19:32:20, dropped to 18.46 at 19:37:20 and 0 at 19:42:20 and 19:47:20; quote produced no STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans in the hour, only STATUS_CODE_UNSET (2938.86).
At 19:45:00Z the span-based error share of service frontend was 4.986% (5-minute rates of traces_span_metrics_calls_total, error spans over all spans of the service).

All 21 pods in otel-demo are phase Running with container restartCount 0 and ready true; the shipping pod is shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn (started 2026-11-17T19:32:17Z, owner ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8), the email pod is email-59f69bc6cf-zwpwn and the quote pod is quote-6b5877698d-6spfl, both started 2026-11-17T18:55:45Z–18:55:46Z.

Services quote, email and shipping all expose port tcp-service 8080 and each has a ready endpoint (quote-6b5877698d-6spfl at 100.96.4.18:8080, email-59f69bc6cf-zwpwn at 100.96.4.155:8080, shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn at 100.96.3.140:8080), so the destination Services/endpoints are not missing and not on the wrong port.

ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config holds 13 flags (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure) and every one has defaultVariant "off" (false or 0), so no fault-injection flag is switched on.

Across the 21 Deployments in otel-demo, shipping is the only one whose address variables contain the literal "quote:0000" (others use host:port or http://host:port, e.g. checkout EMAIL_ADDR="http://email:8080" and SHIPPING_ADDR="http://shipping:8080"); shipping and flagd are the only Deployments at generation 2, the rest are generation 1.

Service email shows only STATUS_CODE_UNSET spans in the hour (3922.55) and no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series, and its pod email-59f69bc6cf-zwpwn is Running and Ready with restartCount 0; the failure text names the email service but the failing span is shipping's own client span and no email span appears in that trace.

The email service is not itself failing: it emitted no error spans in 18:33:37Z–19:47:20Z (only STATUS_CODE_UNSET, 3922.55), its pod is Running/Ready with 0 restarts, and no email span appears anywhere in the failing trace, so the propagated message "failed POST to email service" is not matched by any email-side error evidence.

A flagd fault-injection flag caused the shipping quote failures — rejected: every flag in otel-demo/flagd-config has defaultVariant "off" (false/0), including cartFailure, paymentFailure, productCatalogFailure and emailMemoryLeak, and the ConfigMap contains no shipping-related fault flag.

The quote service itself broke — rejected: quote emitted no error spans (only STATUS_CODE_UNSET, 2938.86/h), its pod quote-6b5877698d-6spfl is Running/Ready with 0 restarts, and its Service endpoint exists on port 8080 with a ready address; its traffic stopped only because shipping's outbound URI became invalid.

The faulting setting is Deployment shipping's literal env QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000": a scheme-less address with port 0000 makes the shipping HTTP client build an unparsable URI (Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat))) and the empty "POST " client span), so /get-quote fails locally and every checkout PlaceOrder needing a shipping quote fails with 13 INTERNAL; the replaced ReplicaSet carried "http://quote:8080".

Restore the shipping container's QUOTE_ADDR to the previously observed value "http://quote:8080" on Deployment otel-demo/shipping, then confirm recovery: frontend/checkout/shipping error spans return to 0, shipping's client span name returns to "POST quote", and quote traffic resumes at roughly its earlier 150–220 calls per 5 minutes.

Review the source that pushed the shipping Deployment change (generation 2 at 19:32:17Z), add validation of service-address variables so a scheme-less or port-0000 value cannot reach the cluster, and correct the error text that names the email service when the failing dependency is the quote address.

gaps: No change-history integration is available in this Run, so who or what changed Deployment shipping's QUOTE_ADDR and the exact moment of that change cannot be verified; the deployment generation 2 and ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8 creation at 19:32:17Z are the only timing evidence, and object state was read after the window.

list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate returned no data (evidence 49cb1ae7-2f81-4788-9de6-2cc0bdddccac-t0:0ce7c0b3-f133-476d-aedd-16f58cdddff4), so the alert expression and the meaning of its reported current value 1.7777777777777777 were not confirmed; metric statements here use traces_span_metrics_calls_total directly.
Secrets cannot be read, so any secret-borne endpoint configuration was not verified.

The email container log read for 19:30:00Z–19:47:20Z returned no lines (no_data), and the quote container log read (19:25:00Z–19:47:20Z) returned no matching error lines (no_data), so absence of application error logs for email and quote is unchecked rather than established; their status rests on span status counts and pod state.
Only 30 of the 233 checkout error spans in the stored result were read; the remaining spans are unknown, although all 30 read carry the identical shipping quote failure description.
kube_deployment_status_replicas_available for deployment shipping returned no data in the window (no_data), so deployment availability was taken from pod status only.

In namespace data-recorders (not otel-demo) the window contains Job Completed/SuccessfulCreate, 5 PVC Provisioning/ProvisioningSucceeded, 7 Pod Created/Scheduled/Started events plus 2 FailedScheduling and 1 VolumeFailedDelete; this activity was not investigated and is not tied to the frontend errors.

Small error-span volumes were observed on ad (about 3/h), fraud-detection (about 3/h) and recommendation (about 4/h) with small steps around 19:38–19:43Z; no evidence ties them to the shipping configuration change and they are not explained here.
next_steps: Have the owner of the otel-demo manifests confirm the intended shipping QUOTE_ADDR value and revert "quote:0000" to "http://quote:8080".
After reverting, re-check frontend/checkout/shipping error span rates, shipping's client span name and quote's request rate to confirm recovery.
Retrieve the RequestErrorRate alert rule definition from the Alertmanager/Prometheus rule files to confirm it is computed from the same span error ratio.
Separately review the data-recorders Job/PVC/Pod activity during the window, which was outside this alert's scope.
